ablation.name: phase4i5a_sota_heun_cosine
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.5a: SOTA (4I.2a Heun) + cosine time schedule. STRUCTURAL: ODE path shape. Theory: cosine schedule t=horizon*(1-cos(pi*i/steps))/2 allocates more integration steps near source (content) and target (style) distributions. Unlike linear which uniformly samples time, cosine is S-shaped: slow at boundaries, fast in middle. This gives the ODE solver more precision where it matters most - near the endpoints where distribution characteristics are defined. Synergy with Heun: higher-order solver + smarter step allocation. If effective, proves ODE path shape is a new structural degree of freedom beyond solver order.
